summary: Aermotor tower, about 100 ft (30.5 m), filed as Mossy Head (Sandy Mtn) in Walton County; sold at auction and removed in fall 2008.

facts.status_note: Sold at auction and removed in fall 2008, per Eastern US Lookouts.

events.note: Sold at auction and removed; the page dates this to fall 2008.

evidence.supports: Tower: 100-foot Aermotor, sold at auction and removed in fall 2008
evidence.quote: Fall 2008: The 100-foot Aermotor tower was sold at auction and removed.

evidence.supports: Page lists the tower under the Choctawhatchee National Forest
Page files the lookout as Mossy Head (Sandy Mtn)
Gazetteer lists a Sandy Mountain Lookout Tower point
evidence.quote: Sandy Mountain Lookout Tower Tower N30.662136° W86.283834°

evidence.supports: Gazetteer lists a Mossy Head Lookout Tower point at nearly the same place
evidence.quote: Mossy Head Lookout Tower Tower N30.662136° W86.284390°

evidence.supports: Congress transferred the national forest to the War Department on June 27, 1940
evidence.quote: On June 27, 1940, Congress transferred the 340,890 acres

evidence.supports: Eglin Air Force Base has occupied the land since
evidence.quote: It has been home to Eglin Air Force Base since.

corrections.why: The page says the tower was sold at auction and removed in fall 2008.
The TopoQuest gazetteer places both lookout points near 30.662, -86.284, about 10 km south-east of the record. Single source; check before applying.
The '>' is page navigation text, not part of the name. Spelling follows Wikipedia; the lookout page spells it Choctawatchee.

notes_for_editor: Fate and design rest on one page (Eastern US Lookouts); no construction date, builder or staffing found in two searches and the pages read, so the story omits them. Coordinates conflict: the record's point is about 10 km north-west of the TopoQuest gazetteer point for both names; correction proposed, not applied. Wikipedia's infobox gives the forest as 1,152 acres while its text says 340,890 acres were transferred in 1940; the story avoids the figure. A search for a 2008 auction notice found nothing, so the auction rests on the one Eastern US Lookouts page.
